howItWorks.title: How It
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps from discovery to outcome — for entrepreneurs, professionals, students, and interns pursuing grants, jobs, internships, trainings, scholarships, and more.

step1.title: Discover Opportunities
step1.description: Browse grants, jobs, internships, trainings, scholarships, fellowships, and other programs. Filter by sector, location, and opportunity type.

step2.title: Join Maali
step2.description: Create your account and profile. Join free as Community to browse, or become a Full Member to apply to any opportunity on the platform.

step3.title: Apply with Confidence
step3.description: Use our guided multi-step application. Upload documents, save drafts, and submit when you're ready — whether you're applying for funding or a career program.

step4.title: Review & Track Outcomes
step4.description: Expert reviewers evaluate applications fairly. Follow status updates in your dashboard through review, feedback, and final selection or award.

about.title: About Maali
about.hero: Maali Opportunity Hub is more than a listing site — it's a trusted bridge connecting African entrepreneurs, professionals, students, and interns with grants, jobs, internships, trainings, scholarships, fellowships, and other programs across the continent.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To democratize access to opportunities — funding, jobs, learning, and career pathways — for African talent, fostering innovation and sustainable economic growth across the continent.

empowerment.title: Empowerment
empowerment.description: Opening doors for founders, professionals, students, and interns to access programs that advance their ventures and careers.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.description: Modern, clear tools that help applicants discover programs and submit strong applications with confidence.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.description: Connecting applicants, program partners, and expert reviewers in one ecosystem built on trust and transparency.

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: Driving real outcomes — grants, placements, fellowships, and career growth — for communities across Africa.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Maali was born from a simple observation: Africa is home to extraordinary talent, yet many founders, professionals, students, and interns still struggle to find and apply for the right opportunities.
story.p2: Our name Maali relates to wealth and value in Somali — reflecting economic opportunity and career growth, not aid alone.
story.p3: Through technology, membership, and a fair review process, we help African talent discover programs, apply with confidence, and track outcomes on one platform.
